description: This file defines an interface 'OAuthTokenProvider' responsible for providing OAuth2 tokens for SMTP authentication within the PHPMailer project. It includes a single method 'getOauth64()' that generates a base64-encoded OAuth token string.

classes.name: OAuthTokenProvider
classes.description: Interface for OAuth2 token providers supporting the generation of base64 encoded OAuth tokens for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: getOauth64
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded OAuth2 token string for SMTP authentication, ensuring the access token is valid.
